subject.title: fix(agents): keep multimodal models when generated catalogs include audio/video inputs

question: Should this PR be the canonical landing path for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97048, and should the broader catalog-core/discovery audio/video preservation from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97858 be ported before merge?
rationale: The code path fix is concrete, but multiple same-root PRs exist and the permanent provider model input metadata breadth is a compatibility/product-scope choice for maintainers.

options.title: Land this proof-positive PR as canonical
options.body: Accept audio/video as additive model input metadata here, merge the smaller proven fix, and close or supersede duplicate candidates after merge.

options.title: Port broader preservation first
options.body: Pull the useful catalog-core/discovery/static-catalog coverage from the broader sibling into one canonical landing path before merge.

options.title: Reject widening and clamp catalogs
options.body: Pause the widening path and replace it with generated-catalog normalization that drops unsupported modalities before registry validation.

recommendation.title: Land this proof-positive PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Accept audio/video as additive model input metadata here, merge the smaller proven fix, and close or supersede duplicate candidates after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to model catalog normalization history and merged the prior configured audio/video input contract change.
